extends.description: Specifies the relative path of a configuration file to integrate.
extends.markdownDescription:
Specifies the **relative path** of a configuration file to integrate.

When set, the current `.qingkuairc` file extends the configuration defined in the referenced file. Options defined in the current file take precedence over the extended file, and the relative path is resolved from the directory of the current configuration file.

For example:

```json
{
    "extends": "./base.qingkuairc"
}
```

preserveHtmlComments.description: Controls whether HTML comment nodes are preserved in the compiled output.
preserveHtmlComments.markdownDescription:
Controls whether HTML comment nodes are preserved in the compiled output.

HTML comments may be useful for debugging, development markers, or tooling that relies on comment nodes.

This option defaults to `development`.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Remove all HTML comment nodes during compilation.
Always preserve HTML comment nodes in the compiled output.
Preserve comment nodes only in development builds.
Preserve comment nodes only in production builds.

interpretiveComments.description: Controls whether QingKuai inserts interpretive comments into the compiled output.
interpretiveComments.markdownDescription:
Controls whether QingKuai inserts **interpretive comments** into the compiled output.

These comments are generated by the compiler to help explain how certain template or reactive constructs were transformed. They are mainly intended for debugging and learning how the compiler works, so they can help you trace how the original template and script were compiled.

Disable this option if you want cleaner compiled output without additional explanatory comments. This option is `true` by default.

allowConstReactive.description: Controls whether constant declarations can be marked as reactive.
allowConstReactive.markdownDescription:
Controls whether **constant declarations** can be marked as **reactive**.

When enabled, variables declared with `const` can be inferred as reactive according to the [reactivity inference rules](https://qingkuai.dev/references/reactivity-infer-rules.html), and can also be explicitly marked with the compiler built-ins `reactive` or `shallow`.

When set to `false`, variables declared with `const` are not inferred as reactive, and explicitly using `reactive` or `shallow` to mark a constant declaration causes a compile error.

This option is `true` by default.

resolveImportExtension.description: Controls how import statements resolve files without explicit extensions.
resolveImportExtension.markdownDescription:
Controls how **import statements without file extensions** are resolved.

When enabled, if an import path does not specify an extension, the compiler will attempt to resolve **`.qk` files before other extensions**.

For example:

```ts
import Component from './Component'
```

will try to resolve:

1. `Component.qk`
2. other supported extensions

Disable this option if you want module resolution to follow the default TypeScript or Node.js behavior. This option is `true` by default.

whitespace.description: Controls how whitespace inside QingKuai templates is handled.
whitespace.markdownDescription:
Controls how **whitespace inside QingKuai templates** is handled during formatting.

Whitespace includes spaces, tabs, and line breaks between template nodes or inside text content. The chosen mode determines how this whitespace is kept, trimmed, or collapsed.

This option defaults to `trim-collapse`.
markdownEnumDescriptions:
Keep whitespace **exactly as written** in the template. Example: ```qingkuai
hello world
``` Result: ```qingkuai
hello world
```

Remove unnecessary whitespace around structural boundaries such as element edges. Example: ```qingkuai
hello world
``` Result: ```qingkuai
hello world
```

Collapse consecutive whitespace characters into a **single space**. Example: ```qingkuai
hello world
``` Result: ```qingkuai
hello world
```

Apply both **trimming** and **collapsing** rules. Example: ```qingkuai
hello world
``` Result: ```qingkuai
hello world
```

reactivityMode.description: Controls the default reactivity constructor used by QingKuai.
reactivityMode.markdownDescription:
Controls which **reactivity constructor** QingKuai uses by default when creating reactive state.

**Options:**

- **`reactive`** — Uses deep reactivity. Nested objects and arrays are also reactive and tracked automatically.
- **`shallow`** — Uses shallow reactivity. Only the top-level value is reactive; nested values are not automatically tracked.

This option defaults to `reactive`.
